purpose: Clarify exact exported declaration safety in the genuine compiled partial-def control; reporting only, not an additional counted control.
observation: The public definition is safe after compilation; two generated executable stages are unsafe. The production audit rejects _cstage1. No definition with safety.partial was observed, so this run does not claim direct exercise of that added predicate branch.
reporting_source:
import Conjecture2187
import Lean
open Lean Elab Command in
run_cmd do
  for (name, info) in (← getEnv).constants.toList do
    let some idx := (← getEnv).getModuleIdxFor? name | continue
    if (← getEnv).header.moduleNames[idx.toNat]! != `Conjecture2187 then continue
    match info with
    | .defnInfo d => logInfo m!"{name}: isUnsafe={info.isUnsafe}; safety.safe={d.safety == .safe}; safety.partial={d.safety == .partial}; safety.unsafe={d.safety == .unsafe}"
    | _ => logInfo m!"{name}: non-definition; isUnsafe={info.isUnsafe}"

command_records.label: compiled-partial-metadata
command_records.stdout:
OutsideNamespace.uncheckedPartial._cstage2: isUnsafe=true; safety.safe=false; safety.partial=false; safety.unsafe=true
OutsideNamespace.uncheckedPartial._cstage1: isUnsafe=true; safety.safe=false; safety.partial=false; safety.unsafe=true
OutsideNamespace.uncheckedPartial: isUnsafe=false; safety.safe=true; safety.partial=false; safety.unsafe=false
